cubicchunks.ores.help:
y is absolute block height. The result is a percent chance (0–100) of a vein center per 12×12×12 cell. Min Y and Max Y are inclusive. No ore is placed at zero chance, even at a vein edge. Veins replace rock only.

Use +  -  *  /  ^  ( ) and comparisons <  <=  >  >=  ==  !=. Functions: min(a,b), max(a,b), abs(a), sin(a), cos(a), clamp(a,min,max), if(condition,yes,no). Use a decimal point. Non-finite results count as 0%.

By points: curve(-1000,40,-600,16,-64,0). Heights must increase. Values interpolate linearly, then stay constant outside the endpoints.

Example: clamp((-64-y)*40/936,0,40). Chance grows from 0% at −64 to 40% at −1000 and stays there. Set Min Y to −1000 to stop the ore below that level. Graph limits only change the preview.
